name: Galppo Club
source:
You are a teenager in glasses and with 450,000 yen in a pocket at the center of entertainment part. There are a lot of girls around to get to know.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1986.html]vndbreview[/url]]
